messages:
deploy-bot: Hotpatch deploy started: runtime-quant-kernel v1.4.3 -> rolling canary to 5% on us-west-2 (a100). trigger: CI hotfix (quant mismatch). ts=1782345678
anya: wait, what mismatch? saw some test flakes earlier but thought fixed
mike: we saw a KV-cache index error on perf tests: sample log below
```
[ERR] kernel_quant.py: line 312 - mismatched dtype for matmul op: expected int8, got int16
Traceback (most recent call last): ...
```
mike: only reproducible on a100-rtb nodes, not on v100
sophia: can we stop canary and pin to v1.4.2? we should avoid wider impact until root cause
deploy-bot: rollback option available: `rdwctl deploy rollback --service runtime --tag v1.4.2 --scope canary`
kai: take a look at build metadata: v1.4.3 included a new quant kernel path (opt-kernel-3) that wasn't in the v1.4.2 blobstore
kai: artifact manifest shows opt-kernel-3 missing symbols for compute capability 8.0
lyn: if this is a capability mismatch we should block v1.4.3 for a100 pool only, allow v1.4.3 on non-a100 for now
anya: that sounds good  we need a quick routing policy change, not a full rollback across the fleet
mike: propose: 1) stop canary 2) pin a100 pool to v1.4.2 3) tag v1.4.3 as broken for a100 4) run a rebuild with the missing kernel symbols
sophia: +1. who will patch routing? ops?
lyn: I'll open a change: `routing policy update: runtime.kernel_tag_override[a100]=v1.4.2`  applying now, ETA 3m
ops-bot: change applied: runtime.kernel_tag_override[a100]=v1.4.2 (by lyn). Audit: CHG-2026
mike: telemetry: all canary requests on a100 are failing rate ~8%, non-a100 canary is OK
kai: also notifying build: @build-team please run a variant rebuild with CC=8.0 flags and include opt-kernel-3 symbols
build-team: ack, kicking off rebuild pipeline (job 8842). ETA ~25m
anya: can we draft a short release note about the rollback and mitigation steps for SRE/Support? I'll write and ping legal if needed
sophia: short note: "v1.4.3 temporarily restricted on A100 due to quant kernel symbol mismatch. Canary stopped; A100 pinned to v1.4.2. Rebuild in progress."
lyn: scheduling a post-deploy sync after rebuild completes. tagging incident if rebuild fails.
deploy-bot: Canary stopped and canary instances scaled down on a100. event_ts=1782345690
mike: marking v1.4.3 as 'restricted:a100' in release registry
anya: thanks all. I'll post the note in #eng-runtime and #support once build confirms
build-team: rebuild finished (job 8842). artifacts uploaded: opt-kernel-3 + CC8.0 symbols. checksum: sha256:abc123...
build-team: recommending canary retry with patched artifact
lyn: re-opening canary at 2% for a100 with v1.4.3-patch. applying traffic shift now
deploy-bot: Canary roll (v1.4.3-patch) started to a100 2%. ts=1782345699
mike: monitoring logs, will call rollback if error rate >2% over 5m
anya: appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
